caldera.shaders.compatibility: Choose Caldera Realistic or a native Caldera pack. Legacy and Iris/OptiFine packs are unsupported.
caldera.backend.title: Caldera shaders are paused
caldera.backend.unavailable: Minecraft is running with OpenGL, so Caldera's Vulkan shaders are paused. You can keep playing without shaders. Vulkan may be unavailable on your graphics device or driver, or disabled by your graphics preference, launch arguments, or startup recovery. To try Vulkan, update your graphics driver and select Prefer Vulkan in Video Settings, then restart Minecraft. If your device does not support Minecraft's Vulkan requirements, continue using OpenGL.
caldera.backend.inactive_short: OpenGL active. Caldera shaders are paused; Vulkan requires a restart.
